newsitem.title: UK: Top yield at UK 3-year Ecu note tender 4.42 pct.
newsitem.headline: Top yield at UK 3-year Ecu note tender 4.42 pct.

text.p: LONDON, July 15, Reuter - The highest accepted yield at the auction of 500 million Ecu of four percent UK Treasury notes due January, 2000 was 4.42 percent, the Bank of England said on Tuesday.
The average yield for the tender was 4.4093 percent while the lowest accepted yield was 4.4000 percent. Bids at the highest accepted yield were allotted pro rata at 70.65 percent.
The 500 million Ecu tender attracted bids of 1.204 billion Ecu.
The notes are fungible with the outstanding one billion Ecu of notes issued in two quarterly tranches this year.
The Bank said it retained a further 50 million Ecu of bonds, bringing the total to 150 million Ecu for lending to listed market makers on request, by means of sale and repurchase operations.
